subject.title: feat: configure metadata (contextWindow, maxTokens, etc.) for custom provider setup

question: Should OpenClaw accept a configure-wizard-only metadata editor for custom providers after the preservation defects are fixed, or should this be folded into the broader onboarding metadata prompt design?
rationale: Automation can repair the source-local metadata preservation bugs, but it cannot choose the final user-facing setup surface for a new interactive provider metadata workflow.

options.title: Repair then review configure-only
options.body: Fix the metadata clobbering bugs, rebase, and review this PR as a configure-wizard feature while keeping onboarding/non-interactive scope tracked separately.

options.title: Fold into canonical onboarding scope
options.body: Pause this PR and require a new implementation that addresses the broader onboarding prompt surface in the canonical issue.

options.title: Do not add this prompt
options.body: Reject the interactive metadata prompt direction and rely on docs, `openclaw models list`, doctor hints, or narrower flags instead.

recommendation.title: Repair then review configure-only
recommendation.body: Fix the metadata clobbering bugs, rebase, and review this PR as a configure-wizard feature while keeping onboarding/non-interactive scope tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the strongest recent history on custom-provider metadata, context-window, image-input, and configure wizard behavior.
